本的生活方式(Ben's Way of Living): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:本的经历、感受与成长。

Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. People around Ben often share different ideas about the night view spot. Ben thanked Max for the honest advice. For example, the new overpass skips six lights.

The subway station has become an important part of daily life. On Saturday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Best of all, the shop sells second-hand goods.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Best of all, grandpa has to stoop to enter the low door.

The experience taught Ben more than any book could. Ben has practiced chess for three years and won a prize last term. Ben plans to study science harder this term. In fact, their investment made the factory bigger.
Little by little, things began to change. Ben is saving money to buy a ticket to Tokyo. At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit.
